style: Wide cinematic YouTube channel banner background, photorealistic, warm golden sepia and amber tones with deep brown shadows, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, moody candlelight, absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no people's faces. The CENTER of the frame must be calm, dark and uncluttered (soft blurred bokeh) so a title can be placed there; interesting details only on the far left and far right edges.

items.prompt: On the far left: an old wedding photograph in a tarnished silver frame and a stack of yellowed handwritten letters tied with twine on a wooden table. On the far right: a lit candle and a vintage envelope with a red wax seal. Rain-streaked window glow in the soft background.

Far left: an antique brass pocket watch and old keys on dark wood. Far right: a single red rose in a glass vase beside a candle and an unopened letter. Warm dusk light through lace curtains, deep shadows in the center.

A long candle-lit family dinner table at night seen from a low angle, extremely soft out-of-focus center, on the far left an empty chair with a folded letter on the plate, on the far right glowing candles and wine glasses, warm amber light.
